items.title: The affine etale site of a directed limit of schemes is the colimit of the affine etale sites
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the affine etale site of a directed limit of schemes with affine transition morphisms is the colimit of the affine etale sites of the approximants (statement lines 7335-7346). The proof treats two cases: the quasi-compact quasi-separated case, where objects and coverings are compared directly through the standard description of affine etale objects over a limit as base changes over some stage (proof lines 7348-7366), and the general case, where an arbitrary affine etale object over the limit is descended to some stage using affineness of the transition morphisms (proof lines 7369-7394). The non-formal content is the descent of objects and coverings to a stage, and the verification that the topologies correspond. The claim is H2: two cases, both written out.
